posts.html:
I thought I would take the liberty of posting you an unban request "a flying superhero sprite"

The server you were banned from:||VM|| Vent Mob [Semi Serious]
Ingame Name: a flying superhero sprite
SteamID: N/A
Ban Reason: Car jacking, lack of roleplay, RDM
Ban Length: Permanent
Admin who banned you: ||VM|| Wyvern
Why we should unban you:
What the fuck are you banned me ! What i have do i payed 400 dansih money and super donater ? ! And you ban me rdm ! Unban me !
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The fact that you donated is irrelevant, and "400 danish money" could equate to about £5 which is by no means a substantial amount. It was entirely your choice that you donated, and the fact that you gave us money does not make you an exception for our own rules.

The reason I banned you was mainly due to stealing a car I had just spawned, proceeding to attempt to run me over, then running over 2 or more people. I agree that a permanent ban might sound harsh, though I personally believe that your presence does not benefit the server in any way. However, if you can reply with a reasonable response, then I may in fact consider unbanning you. Though please attempt to write in relatively comprehendable English, and please do not threaten me with the wrath of the Danish Internet Police.
